independent_checks.note: Same independent tests and docs group as the earlier pilots; one chore-branch run rather than a representative median.

all_checks_target_observation.reason: The test image job was still running and Mocha was blocked more than 12 minutes after workflow creation.

test_image_preparation_snapshot.note: Docker step timings are rounded log values; workspace transfer and the overall job were still running at the observation. This single run does not establish a representative performance change.

arm64_pilot.note: Build timings include image loading; PDF reused runtime layers in the same job. A fresh builder does not prove a cold host. No publication, portal HTTP startup, peak daemon memory, billed-credit measurement, or matched parallel-build comparison was performed. The report retains the initial cleanup failure; the later cleanup step succeeded without establishing its cause.

translation_reporting.note: The previous two pilot jobs exposed zero CircleCI test records for Translation; this run includes the JUnit reporter change.

final_results.note: This single chore-branch workflow did not publish images. API record counts and matching Mocha identities do not prove coverage equivalence; LCOV presence and record counts do not validate source maps or establish coverage parity. A matched baseline and candidate comparison remains required.
